frame: x east along the niche's front, y up from the court's floor, z south (out of the front); metres

span.note: the piers' outer edges: the plan's arc x 10511-10611, 100 px at 4.71 px/m (b); plate 15 and P0641 draw the niche 0.43-0.44 of it

niche_w.note: the niche frame over its posts: 0.43 of the span on plate 15 (191 of 443 px), 0.44 on P0641 (225 of 512 px)

open_w.note: the niche opening: 0.40 of the frame on plate 15, 90 of 225 px on P0641

pier_w.note: the pier's shaft across the front: P0641 76-80 px at 25 px/m; the cornice block 4.2 m (104 px)

pier_d.note: the pier's depth: the plan's band 4.36 m (b); P0214 and P0288 show deep piers, side faces wider than the fronts

pier_fwd.note: the piers stand forward of the niche: the plan draws the band as an arc whose ends come south

foot.note: the piers' and the niche's foot on the plinth course, at the gardens' level: the court is sunk 1.30 m (S603, survey, B); the courses step down from it to the basin (P0641)

pier_h.note: pier foot to cornice top: P0641, 214 px at 25 px/m (the shaft's width the scale); plate 15 draws it 11.5 m at the plan's scale, its heights stretched (k about 1.3)

flare_h.note: the console foot under the shaft: P0641 89-95 px

cap_h.note: the pier's crowning cornice block: plate 15 25 px of 240

finial_h.note: the vase finial over each pier: plate 15, 0.53 of the pier's height (126 of 240 px); gone by 1873 (P0776). The dossier's 14.3 m top is the same reading by the plate's module

post_cap.note: the niche posts' caps, where the head springs: level with the piers' cornice on P0641 (510 and 513 px) and on plate 15 (671 and 670)

head_rise.note: the arch head's rise over the post caps: 0.41 of the frame on plate 15, 0.39 on P0762 (its back)

head_in.note: the head stands this far inside the frame's outer edge each side: the posts' caps stick out about 25 px beyond it on P0641; v1's full-width head was 0.9-1.6 m too wide on P0641, P0340, P0169 and P0776

head_d.note: the head is a deep hood: its shoulder scrolls run back as drums on P0214 and P0288, 0.5-0.8 of its width (the ruin reader); 3 m, C

open_top.note: the opening's top on the axis, 0.75 m over the post caps: P0641 19 px, plate 15 15 px

crest_h.note: the shell crest over the head: plate 15 0.58 of the frame (5.3 m) at its stretched heights; whole in 1873 (P0776)

post_d.note: the posts' depth: as the head

cascade_steps.note: the seven-step water curtain in the niche (S310, B); plate 15 draws about seven lips below the lion mask

mask_y.note: the lion mask's mouth above the foot: plate 15 draws it 34 px below the post caps; v1's 8.0 m sat 1.8 m above the plate's fit

terrace_y.note: the 远瀛观 terrace above the court, where the stairs arrive: plate 15 draws the parapets' curl at the piers' flare (789 and 812 px), 4.3 m over the piers' foot by P0641's heights; P0776's balustrade stands over it; the ground behind the niche on P0762 at about the same level. XY09's terrace box raised to 4.3 m to meet it (Q232)

stair_w.note: each flight's width: the plan's hatched blocks at the arc's ends (CCX-023, 024), about 3 m

stair_ang.note: the flights' turn from the front: the hatched blocks run on the diagonal, out and forward from the arc's ends; plate 14 draws two stairs embracing 大水法

stair_run.note: a flight's run: 30 steps of 0.155 m on treads of 0.28 m; the plan's blocks are about 8 m on the diagonal

basin_w.note: the lobed basin's width on the ruin (S850 view); the plan draws 29.5 m

basin_z0.note: its north edge before the base courses: the pool's centre 12.0 m south of the niche's box middle (ruin), less half its depth

basin_z1.note: its front on the axis: 16.4 m deep on the ruin (C); the plan draws 21 m

rim_h.note: the rim above the court; a low rail of small posts on its front (plate 15)

stag_z.note: the stag's base: the plan's middle rectangle in the pool

stag_h.note: the stag on its rock: plate 15 draws it 77 px from base to antler tips at the basin's depth

hounds.note: ten hounds round the stag: the plan's ten small rectangles in a ring; plate 15 shows about four a side leaping at it

tower_x.note: the two tower basins' centres 62 m apart, symmetric about the axis (S603, survey); the ruin readings put the east basin 5.6 m further south than the west (Q234)

tower_z.note: their line across the axis: 17.8 m south of the niche's box middle, the mean of the two ruin readings; S01's water bodies 17.5-18.4

basin_d.note: the tower basins, 18 m across, quatrefoil (S603); plate 15 draws a lobed oblong with a straight front and concave corners

ped_w.note: the pedestal, square: the plan 4.6 m (b), plate 15 the same

ped_h.note: the pedestal's height above the water: plate 15, 0.69 of its width at its stretched heights (6.7 m), less the plate's stretch

tiers.note: the pyramid's tiers: plate 15 draws ten (the reader, +-1); S310's '13 steps' is a search extract, the page not confirmed

pyr_h.note: the pyramid with its pinnacle above the pedestal: plate 15, 2.4 times the pedestal

tier_b.note: the bottom tier's width: 0.72 of the pedestal's front on plate 15

tier_t.note: the top tier's width: 0.19 of the pedestal's front

jets.note: about forty jets a tower in two rings, the tallest 1.8 times the pedestal (plate 15)
